executive_summary: Across 96,478 total orders and 13,221,498.11 in revenue, customer retention remains critically depressed with only 3.0% repeat buyers among 93,358 unique customers. Delivery reliability is the primary driver of customer dissatisfaction, as late deliveries yield an average review score of 2.56 compared to 4.29 for on-time fulfillment. Severe operational bottlenecks are isolated in regional delivery routes such as AL and MA, alongside recurring delay spikes and specific underperforming merchant accounts.

insights.root_cause: Only 3.0% of 93,358 unique customers completed repeat purchases against the 5.0% benchmark.
insights.recommendation: Launch targeted re-engagement campaigns and post-purchase loyalty promotions to first-time buyers.
insights.expected_impact: Increase customer retention from 3.0% toward the 5.0% benchmark.

insights.problem: Late deliveries severely depress review ratings
insights.root_cause: The 7,655 late orders averaged an review score of 2.56, compared to 4.29 across 88,177 on-time orders.
insights.recommendation: Enforce strict fulfillment SLAs with logistics partners to keep shipments within the 12.6 day average.
insights.expected_impact: Eliminate the 1.73 point review penalty associated with late deliveries and lift overall satisfaction.

insights.problem: Regional delivery breakdown in AL and MA
insights.root_cause: Late delivery rates reached 24.1% in AL across 397 orders and 20.4% in MA across 717 orders, well above the 8.11% national rate.
insights.recommendation: Reallocate regional volume to higher-performing regional carriers and renegotiate freight rates where MA freight share hits 26.3%.
insights.expected_impact: Lower regional late shipment rates toward the national baseline of 8.11% and raise state review scores from 3.76-3.82.

insights.root_cause: Late delivery rates surged to 15.7% in 2018-02 and 20.5% in 2018-03 against the 6.86% baseline, driving 1-2 star reviews to 21.2%.
insights.recommendation: Implement dynamic carrier capacity planning to handle volume surges without breaching delivery timelines.
insights.expected_impact: Prevent monthly late delivery spikes above the 6.86% benchmark and reduce negative reviews below 12.29%.

insights.root_cause: Seller 2eb70248 generated 38,991 across 187 orders but produced a 2.81 average review score and 14.2% late delivery rate.
insights.recommendation: Issue a mandatory operational improvement plan and restrict listing visibility until fulfillment metrics meet standard thresholds.
insights.expected_impact: Lift seller review score toward the 4.0 benchmark and lower seller late deliveries below 14.2%.

insights.problem: Low customer satisfaction in office furniture
insights.root_cause: Office furniture generated an average review score of 3.52 across 1,254 orders with an 8.9% late delivery rate against the 4.16 platform benchmark.
insights.recommendation: Audit bulky freight handling and packaging standards for office furniture merchants to prevent transit damage and delays.
insights.expected_impact: Improve category review score from 3.52 closer to the marketplace average of 4.16.
